name: Nether Earth: world
summary: The world turn: each robot's step (sight, fire, steering by order, movement) and each shot's flight.

entries.name: WorldTurn
entries.summary: one game turn of the world: the enemy commander, every robot, every shot

entries.name: UpdateRobot
entries.summary: one robot's game turn: dying, destroyed or a step of its AI

entries.name: RobotStep
entries.summary: a live robot: wait for its step delay, then look, fire, steer and move one step

entries.name: SteerByOrder

entries.name: TargetRobotRecord

entries.summary: move shot IY 2 cells, then hit a wall, an object or fly on

entries.name: ShotGone
entries.summary: out of range or off the map: the shot is gone with the short sound
